title: W11169659 — Service Test Mode
description: From Service Diagnostics, press 2nd button then START — L1/L2/heater/airflow; step 8 verifies water spray.

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool & Maytag 27 in Front-Load Gas & Electric Dryers Service Manual

steps.title: Enter Service Test Mode
steps.body: With Service Diagnostic mode active, press and release the 2nd diagnostic button, then press and release START. Door must be closed. Press START to begin L2 → L1 → heater → airflow sequence. Step 8 verifies water valve spray.
steps.sourceExcerpt: User enters Service Test Mode through Service Diagnostics.
